messages:
ada: FYI cost dashboard spike at 00:00 UTC — redwood-rlhf-1 unit_cost doubled for several small tenants. saw this after the midnight rebalancer. anyone else?

jon: same. looks like credit TTL/epoch weirdness — many prefetch credits have credit_expires_at = 1970-01-01. dashboard comparator treats that as never-expire, so credits get reapplied daily.

priya: routing rebalances at midnight also cause more fallbacks. retries + fallbacks are currently folded into model unit_econ, inflating cost. PM wants a split view for transient vs steady spend.

ryan: quick mitigation: clamp credits with epoch <= 1970-01-02 to expire immediately in aggregation pipeline. can push a 5-min hotfix.

deploy-bot: deploy: hotfix/ttl-clamp -> prod at 2026-03-22T00:05:12Z (sha: f1a2b3). Canary: 2/2 ok.

ada: ada: jon, please open bug for grant path defaulting null expiry. I'll coordinate with SDK folks.

jon: filed GH #5821 with repro steps.

priya: UX request: add toggle to model-econ chart to stack out `retries` and `fallbacks` as separate lines. helps PMs understand transient noise.

ryan: will add `routing_meta` fields to aggregation response (flattened for now). also adding header `x-routing-fallback` in proxy logs for easier filtering. PR tomorrow.

ada: ada: also add alert: daily model-level unit_cost deviation >20% vs 7-day rolling for top-50 tenants. would have caught this earlier.

jon: adding alert and a CI dashboard test: display_total vs billing_preview <10% for top tenants.

priya: timeline: hotfix deployed, UX mock by EOW, logging header PR tomorrow, bug fix in grant path next sprint. leaving thread open until alerts stable. :rocket:
